paragraphs: Nexus Notes (formerly Lane Tracker) is a League of Legends stats site: lane matchup dashboards, ranked history, live games, the pro meta and esports. It started as a lane matchup tracker, and that tracker is still at its core. Point it at one player (solo) or two players who queue together (duo), pick the roles you care about, and it pulls the last 90 days of games and shows how you do against every champion you've laned against.
For every game where the tracked players were in their chosen roles, it records:

It also pulls the last 120 days of pro games from Leaguepedia for the same roles, so you can see which champions and pairs pros play most and win most with, how they rune and build them, and which of them you've tried.
features: every champion in the game, by position, on both teams

lane stats against each player's direct opponent and for the lane as a whole: gold, XP and CS at 15 minutes, gold minute by minute, lane kills and deaths before 15, end gold, damage, vision, KDA, kill participation
u.gg carry scores (hard carry and teamplay) for all ten players
every player's runes, summoner spells, final items and the order they completed their items

how the same lane matchup usually goes in global games at your rank (Iron–Gold, Gold–Emerald, Gold+, Platinum+ or Emerald+), so you can spot lanes you lose that you should win, and the other way round
